raw_query_redacted: How do I authenticate with apiKey [REDACTED_API_KEY] and postgres://[REDACTED_CONNECTION_STRING] to search records in v3.0?
answer_text:

Here is the runnable code snippet conforming to SDK v3.0 specifications:

from sdk import Client

# SDK v3.0 Search Implementation

    print(item["id"])
